responsibility: This file implements the DMD `Compiler` interface expected by the shared D frontend using GCC services. Its main responsibilities are compile-time reinterpret-cast support by encoding and reinterpreting constant GCC trees, and frontend callbacks for imported modules: recognizing special modules such as `object` and `gcc.builtins`, triggering construction of runtime typeinfo and builtin-module contents, and deciding whether ordinary imports should be treated as compiler-provided builtin modules.
